headline: 4 Securities & Exchanges Stocks to Watch Despite Intense Competition
summary: Zacks Securities and Exchanges industry players like CME, ICE, NDAQ and CBOE gain from rising crypto adoption, a higher non-trading revenue base and tech investments. However, competition remains a drag.

headline: NDAQ Q2 Deep Dive: AI Adoption, IPO Momentum, and Platform Expansion Drive Growth
summary: Global exchange operator Nasdaq (NASDAQ:NDAQ) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 14.9% year on year to $1.5 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.07 per share was 8.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
